== General Quest Info ==

===Obtaining Dufrenite===

You can buy [[Dufrenite]] from a merchant in your hometown, or from someone who got a drop. Dufrenite rarely drops in [[Solusek's Eye]] (Sol A) from clockwork gnomes. So far I have paid an average of 60pp per Dufrenite off using /auction. I haven't had to buy one from the merchant in [[Grobb]], but it sells for 154pp there. The Grobb Merchants name is Zumzal, and he is in the Shaman Guild area. Dufrenite can also be purchased from [[Murtog MacYee]] in [[Halas]].

===Processing Dufrenite===

The Ogre Shamans in [[Lake Rathetear]] at loc 3000,-1900 will crush/grind/powder Dufrenite for you. 

[[Grud]] makes the [[Crushed Dufrenite]].

[[Trug]] makes the [[Powdered Dufrenite]].

[[Punga]] makes the [[Ground Dufrenite]].

Make sure you have the right state of Dufrenite! If you turn in powder when it calls for crushed they will take all your items and leave you with nothing!


===Doing the turn-in===

Give the items to [[Vrynn]] or [[Kyralynn]], at the Barbarian Village in Lake Rathetear (loc 500, 2500). It is not indistinct who you give your items to, chose the right NPC according to the following, or your items will be lost.

Vrynn will return:
Totemic Boots, 
Totemic Greaves, 
Totemic Vambraces, 
Totemic Gauntlets.

Kyralynn will return:
Totemic Bracers, 
Totemic Cloak, 
Totemic Helm, 
Totemic Breastplate.

They '''only accept Medium banded armor''' for these quests, not small or large. Medium banded does not actually say "Medium" on it. It is just called banded armor. So don't run all the way there with your large banded gauntlets and get stonewalled by Vrynn, or run all the way there with the ringmail gauntlets you got while farming the Centaur Charger for his chips, thinking you have your banded gauntlets with you. ([[Smithing]])

==[[Totemic Breastplate]]==

{{:Totemic Breastplate}}
* [[Crushed Dufrenite]]
* [[Banded Mail]]
* [[Grizzleknot Bark]] ([[Grizzleknot]], [[Southern Karana]]) (lvl 28)
* [[Lancer Swordfish Fin]] ([[A Lancer Swordfish]] lvl28-lvl32; [[A Piercer Swordfish]] lvl35-lvl37; [[An impaler swordfish]] lvl39) [[Kedge Keep]]

[[Grizzleknot]] is a rare spawn in South Karana. He paths from the Treants in the NE corner, down past the Hermit's House in the SE corner of the zone. I got the bark while I was exping at the Centaur Stables. He ran right by, I alerted one of the higher level necros also killing centaurs, who killed him and let me loot the bark. (Thanks Evyl!!)  He also drops the Treant Staff that procs root, and the Cloak of Leaves. I have seen him alot more often on p1999 than I remember on live. A good way to spawn Grizzleknot is stand around 567, 783 and kill anything that paths by. Using this method I was able to spawn two Grizzleknots in a little over an hour.

On 03/20/2021 I spawned Grizzleknot at loc -535, -315. Placeholder is centaur foal (always) on 32 min timer. PH will roam so kill all centaur foals in area around centaur village, bard well and undead pyramid and monitor spawn loc. Took me about 10-12 PHs. -Garku on Green server. 

[[A Lancer Swordfish]] is the harder thing to kill for the Breastplate. Though they are warriors, the lower level Lancers are swimming in the entry lobby to Kedge alongside Piercers and Impalers. Unless you are a high level shaman, there is no way to single pull a Lancer without aggroing the rest. Take someone who can calm or a monk, ideally. I duo'd this on my level 42 shaman with a druid by having me pull the fish while the druid was invis. He would root and we zoned out, zoned back in, and then killed the rooted mob.

==[[Totemic Cloak]]==

{{:Totemic Cloak}}
* [[Powdered Dufrenite]]
* [[Banded Cloak]]
* [[Driftwood Pipe]] ([[An isle goblin chieftan]], [[Ocean of Tears]])  (lvl26)
* [[Basalt Drake Scales]] ([[A Basalt Drake]] lvl26; [[A drake]] lvl24-lvl27) [[Rathe Mountains]]

[[A Basalt Drake]] are in the Rathe Mtns. The exact loc of the basalt drake is -1281, 743. It is a static spawn on p1999, instead of having to kill drake PH's and run all over the zone to kill them. (watch out for Rharzar in this area, he walks directly through the basalt drake spawn and is a level 55 KOS green drake. I had the misfortune of being killed by this roamer twice before landing my scales.) The scales are not 100% drop. There is an Onyx Drake next to the Basalt Drake that drops over 1pp potentially. Something to kill while you wait. 

[[An isle goblin chieftan]] is in OoT at spot #9 on the map. The chieftain or his PH wizard spawn in a hut guarded by two goblin headhunters,(occasionally one is a lower /con warrior). The chief and his headhunter guards are blue to lvl 30.(The wizard place holder will also drop the Driftwood Pipe, but much more rarely.) Note that the chief is a rare spawn. I had to kill the wizard PH 10+ times before he spawned. The pipe is not 100% drop from the chieftain either, so this part may take you some time.

==[[Totemic Helm]]==

[[File:totemic_helm_turnin.png|300px|right|thumb|Turnin]]

NPC: [[Kyralynn]]

{{:Totemic Helm}}
* [[Ground Dufrenite]]
* [[Banded Helm]]
* [[Glacier Bear Pelt]] ([[A Glacier Bear]], caves in [[Everfrost Peaks]]) (lvl27)
* [[Ogreskin Chamois]] ([[A lizard page]] lvl23-25 [[Cazic Thule]])

[[A Glacier Bear]] is found in the Everfrost cave that can be reached by dropping down into the frozen lake in one of the openings ({{Loc|Everfrost|-850, -1480}}, {{Loc|Everfrost|20, -4500}}{{Loc|Everfrost|1375, -4600}}) and swimming down to the end of the West fork. You shouldn't need underwater breathing unless you have no swimming skill whatsoever as you can just swim along the top until you get to the portion where the opening actually is. The bear spawns near the 3way fork towards Sulon McMoor and is on an 6-8 hour spawn cycle with 2 Iced Bone Skeletons as its place holder. Both the bear and the skeletons patrol the entire cave when they spawn. A good strategy for finding him is to simply sit in the back of the cave and cast Sense Animal; if he is there, you will target him. He is level 27-30, is immune to frost damage and does hit you for about 40-50 damage, but is easily soloable by a 31; just Root, Dot, repeat. '''Look out for [[Lich of Miragul]], a level 45 necromancer. He has a huge agro range and can outrun sow.'''

[[a lizard page]] can be found in the throneroom as a fairly frequent spawn. Find a throneroom group and you'll see him a number of times. Seems to drop every time. If attempting to get this mob solo, pages can also frequent the maze. Buff endure magic, as he will try nuke you with cleric nukes. Just pull to the courtyard or zone line and kill, being sure to bash when he tries to heal. You will have an easier time getting a solo lizard pull from the maze, as lizards path near the door to the courtyard. Lizard pages can also be found in the room directly above the alligator pit (the small pool of water south of location #4 on the main level).

==[[Totemic Greaves]]==

{{:Totemic Greaves}}
* [[Powdered Dufrenite]]
* [[Banded Leggings]]
* [[Permafrost Snowball]] ([[a goblin wizard (Permafrost)|goblin wizard]], [[Permafrost]]) (lvl23)
* [[Bone Barbs]] ([[a barbed bone skeleton]], [[Unrest]]) (lvl24)

[[a goblin wizard (Permafrost)|goblin wizard]]s are all around Permafrost. Depending on your level, you could either easily duo or solo this. It is my suggestion to make an expedition out of your trip to Perma. Take a friend or two and work the spawn points. Even as low as 17, with a full group you'll have a profitable and fun jaunt here. You might get an upgrade, and you will certainly get the snowball to drop.

[[a barbed bone skeleton]] are in Unrest. I got mine by sitting next to a group killing them. They called the camp spot the "FP" or Fire Place, on the second floor. Its also easy to get Ghoul Carrion here, from the Carrion Ghouls that are usually being pulled by this group. They also have a chance to spawn in most of the spots in the basement's main room as well as the two spots just after the bookcase. So, if you're able to handle the hags, head downstairs. I saw at least two spawn each cycle. ["It only took 27 kills to get one bone barb here." -Daidhid] They are also a random spawn at the western undead temple in rathe mountains.

{{:Totemic Vambraces}}

* [[Ghoul Carrion]] ([[a carrion ghoul]], [[Unrest]]) (lvl20)

[[centaur charger]]s are in South Karana at the Centaur Stables. I got my chips at lvl19, the stables appear to be permacamped at all hours of the day or night, I just asked if I could loot the corpses (Thanks Fross!!), and got my chip in about 5 minutes.

[[a carrion ghoul]]s are in Unrest and typically on the 2nd floor of the house. Try getting into the "FP" or Fire Place group, on the second floor, or just waiting patiently nearby until ghoul carrion drops, which is fairly common.

==[[Totemic Boots]]==

{{:Totemic Boots}}
* [[Dufrenite]]
* [[Banded Boots]]
* [[Terror Spines]] ([[a tentacle terror]]) (lvl23)
* [[Chief's Tongue]] ([[Orc chief]], [[Lesser Faydark]]) (lvl18)

[[a tentacle terror|tentacle terror]]s spawn in both Najena and Unrest. I got mine in Unrest the same way I got my barbed bones. The spawn in Najena is very easy to get to, whereas the spawn in Unrest is almost impossible solo. 

[[Orc chief]] presides over a camp of Orcs in Lesser Faydark. At lvl23, all the other Orcs in the camp were green, so I was able to solo pull the Chief. He was blue to me, I just tanked him while the dots worked. Tongue dropped on the 1st kill. He is located on [[Lesser Faydark|this map]] at number 9.

==[[Totemic Gauntlets]]==

{{:Totemic Gauntlets}}
* [[Crushed Dufrenite]]
* [[Banded Gauntlets]]
* [[Mammoth Rib Bone]] ([[a wooly mammoth]], [[Everfrost Peaks]]) (lvl22-26)
* [[Griffenne Downfeather]] ([[a griffenne]], [[Northern Karana]]) (lvl23-27)

These drops were pretty easy. I was able to solo both the Mammoths and Griffenne at lvl21 (both red) without too much trouble. Root and Dot works well. 

[[a wooly mammoth]]s are plentiful. I farmed my ribs outside of the Permafrost Keep zone line, in case I had to bail. I got the ribs on my 2nd kill, but lost them when I tried to turn in Large Banded instead of Medium Banded for the quest. The 2nd time around I killed about 10 of them without a drop, then a nice necro (Thanks Asahi!!) sent me a tell out of the blue with the /loc of a mammoth he had killed. The worst part about this is the run to Everfrost. If you are an evil race, I suggest binding in the Gypsy Camp in North Karana, making the run, and gating back. Watch out for the 2 Barbarian guard types on the way out onto the tundra. If you have to ditch into Permafrost Keep, hug the wall on the left to avoid Ice Giant agro.

[[a griffenne]]s were a bitch to find without track. At first I just ran around North Karana killing all the Griffawns I saw until I found a Griffenne. I actually got to lvl22 doing this, but only killed 1 Griffenne in this time. I then enlisted the help of a passing Ranger to track some down. We found 1 static spawn and 1 roaming spawn. After that farming the downfeather was just a matter of time. The roaming spawn flies from the Gypsy Camp to the druid rings and back. This spawn has a Griffawn PH. The static spawn is down the road west of the Gypsy Camp. Follow the road west until you see a house on the right hand side. Stop and turn left. You will see a stand of trees with a Griffenne and a Griffawn at -320, 1615. The Griffawn did not add when the Griffenne is pulled. (At least at lvl22) I did not keep track of how many Griffenne I killed, but it was a bunch. Each one took a full bar of mana and alot of Root/Dot action, but I was always full again by the time the next one spawned. I eventually got this down to were I could kill the Griffenne, the Griffawn that spawned next to her, and 1 or 2 passing grizzlies before the respawns. I made enough from the HQ bear pelts to buy another Dufrenite. Make sure you get the Downfeather, and not just the regular feather.

==[[Totemic Bracers]]==

{{:Totemic Bracers}}
* [[Dufrenite]]
* [[Banded Bracer]]
* [[Bull Elephant Tooth]] ([[a bull elephant]], [[Southern Karana]]) (lvl20-24)
* [[Cauldron Shell]] ([[aqua goblin tidal lord]], [[Dagnor's Cauldron]]) (lvl23)

[[a bull elephant]]s. I killed 2 of these before I got my tooth. One at -6503, 1945, and one directly west of Aviak City (city was in view). Was blue at lvl22, and was an easy kill. Thanks for Jeah for tracking the 2nd one for me. Bull elephants also path north of the centaur camp. Typically there are more elephants in general near Aviak city, increasing their spawn chances if you kill any kind of elephant in the area.

[[aqua goblin tidal lord]]s spawn at area 5 on [[Dagnor's Cauldron|this map]]. They are yellow to me at lvl22. The camp has 4 spawn points, and can spawn 3 different types of mobs, Mariners, Shamans, and Tidal Lords. The Mariners were either green or light blue. The Shamans were always blue. The Tidal Lords were always yellow. I killed 18 Tidal Lords before I got my shell. Setup on the west side of the camp. I got random rat and skeleton agro while medding on the south/north/east sides, as well as mob trains from people running to Unrest.
